accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, timeline nodes, tabs, specific cards) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Example: data-testid='search-player-input', data-testid='new-rumor-btn'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on #0D1B2A meets APCA standards. Volt Green text must be bolded to ensure readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use a Dark Theme with #0D1B2A as main background and #121620 for cards.
Implement a 3-Panel grid layout: Left (3 cols), Center (6 cols), Right (3 cols) on large screens. Stack them on mobile.

PANEL A (Left): Add a predictive search bar with MagnifyingGlass icon. Below it, design a striking Contract Card with the player image provided in media. Use Volt Green (#39FF14) for the 'Registra Nuovo Rumor' button.
PANEL B (Center): Implement a vertical chronological Timeline for the player 'sagas'. Use different dot colors based on rumor stage (Interesse = Gray, Trattativa = Magenta, Ufficiale = Volt).

PANEL C (Right): Build the Consistency Check Widget with Fuchsia (#FF007F) borders and warnings for contradictory reports. Below it, create a Source Directory list with reliability scores (progress bars).
Use @phosphor-icons/react for icons. Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion date-fns`.
Apply 'Outfit' font for headings and 'Manrope' for body. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Use the provided image URLs for the player avatars and context imagery.
Ensure the design feels urgent, energetic, and professional, like a high-end Italian sports broadcast.
